references.text: Warns against following other gods, which can lead to destruction, paralleling the warning in Matthew to remove what leads to sin.
Speaks of great peace for those who love God's law and that nothing can cause them to stumble, contrasting with what causes one to stumble in Matthew.
Encourages removing obstacles from the path of the righteous, similar to the exhortation in Matthew to remove what causes one to stumble.
Jesus gives similar teaching about cutting off a hand or foot and casting it away to avoid hell, paralleling Matthew.
Warns about the seriousness of leading someone into sin, a theme similar to that in Matthew regarding removing causes of sin.
